column1: # Per-file count of PROSE literals OUTSIDE UI positions (design-marathi §3.3 b): a Latin word beside a
# space, or a capitalised word, that is neither listed in unkeyed.tsv nor marked `// text:value <why>`.
# I18nLiteralTest fails when a file's count differs. A rise means a new literal: key it, list it in
# unkeyed.tsv (a text a person sees), or mark its line `// text:value <why>` (a log line, a wire value,
# a code); each of the three lowers the count. A fall: run gradle :pano:i18nRatchet, which only ever
# LOWERS these counts. Never raise one by hand.
